content:
Amazon’s early fall Prime Day sale is in full swing with thousands of price drops already up for grabs. While there will be plenty more Apple gear dropping in price come next week, we are already seeing AirTag 2 at the lowest price yet, $500 off this M5 Pro MacBook Pro, up to $150 off MacBook Air models, and discounts on some of Apple’s latest releases.

All of those, of course, join up to $1,200 off smart TVs, loads of MagSafe chargers, and power banks, as much as 50% off Amazon’s smart speakers and displays, smart home upgrades, and more. Head below for a closer look and be sure to check back as we will be updating this post right up until next week.
